translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

content: Yohane Doku Tau Tauŋo Anutu Wane Don Ra Qelaŋanmaike

Taiberius Sisa eŋe koma 15 Roman kepe ware ware suaine geke. Pakiso, eŋane ketkele, Pontius Pilat eŋe Yuda kepeo ŋei waom geke, ŋo Herot, eŋe Pilat wane ketkele, eŋe Galili kepeo ŋei waom gekiso, ŋole Pilip, eŋe Iturea so Trakonitis kepeo ŋei waom geke. Ŋo Lisanias eŋe Abilene kepeo ŋei waom geke.
Ŋo mosop ŋei ŋetne etke gekoik, Anas so Kaiapasi, naso yewao Zekaraia wane gipole Yohane eŋe kepe yaup papaino gekiso, Anutu wane donŋo ketno ketke.
Pakiso, Yohane eŋe Yordan doku erinat so inat geware more, ŋei ŋerep iwa yale edane rake, “Ŋine borikineŋine ŋadek kawareu paki, doku taukei, Anutuŋo sot turuŋŋine qeliŋwareake.”
Anutu wane qelit ŋei, propet Isaiaŋo ea wane done iwa yale dere more qeke,

content.text: “Kepe yaup papaino ŋei maneŋo boka woka mane iwa yale ramaike, ‘Waom wane numa makoboeu, numaine kitou digin qekep!
Wagemine korop somewareu, meŋoine so bonagaine korop kito kito pelekeu digin qekep. Duma kuŋ qegoŋine kito koboeu koboekep, so kito wa kito ketine ma sorokeu, qe leleke ket sorodoŋgep.
Paki daleo Anutuŋo ŋei ŋerep ma menaŋoniake, ea wane kine eŋe kaulukkei.’”

content: Ŋei ŋerep magu suaineŋo doku tau tau wane Yohane wano lotke warekoi, pakimo Yohaneŋo edange, “Ŋine koma wane doko ŋosakoune, ŋine Anutu wano ŋine borikinane turuŋine zingeakane okanmaike, yewa kakak kaikei wane maŋo ŋidange me?

Ŋine wetŋine mainge ware more, ea wane weleine maratkau, so ŋine ŋidomka misuk kieke more, ŋene Abraham wane ŋabokoune raikei, na ŋidanmaile, Anutu eŋe maine wesi iwaŋo maki Abraham wane ŋabokoune koso musele maine wakongei!
Naka mo eki kino mot mole, ea wane eki mane eŋe wele maine mi qeki, kitare more gerepko pekekeu zeake.”
Pakiso, ŋei ŋerep eŋe qesonka rakoi, “Ŋene daleo okanikene?”
Rauso, eŋe mainge edange, “Ŋei mane eŋe takot etke mage more, takot mane kimaine takot midaine ka more, eŋe maniake. Ŋei mane eŋe ŋaraine weneŋŋo rokop, yalewaka okaniake.”
Pakiso, takis mama eŋe yaleka doku taukei wane lotke more, qesonka rakoi, “Kito ŋebo ŋebon ŋene daleo okanikene?”
Rauso edange, “Ŋine ŋei eŋano ŋine takis maikei wane raraine, rokop yewa yale waka ma okanikei, ŋinŋine wetŋino misuk qeyau kere koso takotke maikei.”

Kawali ŋei natneŋo yale waka qesonka rakoi, “Ŋo ŋenewa? Ŋene daleo okanikene?” Rauso, eŋe edane rake, “Ŋine ŋei engu kito, me isi more wesiene zok yaup misuk omakongei, ŋine wesiŋine ma okanmami, yewa wane rokopka maikei.”
Yohaneŋo Yesu Wane Kine Ra Qelaŋane edange
Pakiso ŋei ŋerep eŋe weteno saqe saqe okangi, dere siuke more rakoi, “Eŋe Mesia me mida?”

Yohaneŋo korop edane rake, “Noŋo dokuka tauŋunmaile, mane ŋadeno sarimaike, eŋe zonomine zok manerop pa manmaike. Eŋe naŋane rokop mida, namde eŋane qelit qeqe meine. Oŋo ŋine natne boaŋ Asu Koboboine ŋiboniake, ŋo ŋine natne gerepŋo ŋizoyake.
Eŋe sawoliinerop sari more, ŋaraine eune ma more wele peikki urumgo wayake, ŋo ŋei sinoine yewamo peikki gerep togongo wa more ezowareake.”
Yohaneŋo numa tanik kine kineo more, biŋek don ŋei ŋerep edange, so gege mageene qotkoine qeliŋkaikei wane qebinonge, so miti edange.
Pakimo ŋei waomene Herot, eŋe ŋolane ŋanomine Herodias kobu make, so borikine natne weneŋ make, ea wane Yohaneŋo girem don olatke.
Herot eŋe sot yewa okange, so koso takotke more sot mane kakapa suaine manerop okange, eamo Yohane mulap urumgo birakake.
Yohaneŋo Yesu Doku Taukake
Ŋei ŋerep loutne eŋe Yohane wano lotke more doku taukoi, pakiso Yesu eŋe yalewaka ari more tauke. Tau more meŋenka metkiso, qeli aŋaŋge.

Pakiso, Asu Koboboineŋo sola bikum gorop okane, baluse yale lele more, so Yesu wane kutno ketke. Pakiso, qeliwo ŋine don mane iwa yale raki sarike, “Ge nae gipon maepne, na geŋane zok similenan okanmaike.”
Yesu Wane Ŋosa Wili Wilikoune
